assets.name: Combat Endurance
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: Image 1, the original 64x64 Starsector Combat Endurance skill icon. Image 2 is a color/style reference only, the approved Peerless Helmsmanship icon. Create a faithful GOLD recolored variant of IMAGE 1 for the Peerless tier. Preserve its exact square composition, all existing objects, silhouettes, thin technical diagrams, orbital curves, tiny original lettering and line geometry. Preserve neutral whites, blacks and dark negative space. Convert the colored glow, colored linework and colored surfaces to luminous metallic GOLD, warm amber midtones and pale champagne highlights, matching the approved reference palette. Retain high contrast and crisp details at the game's tiny icon size. No new border, trim, badge, emblem, symbols, text, objects, star markers or changed geometry. Keep the existing black background black and preserve existing transparency. This is a palette recolor of the existing bitmap, not a redesign. Output one square icon filling the image edge to edge.
